text: Newborn, female. The patient is a 3000-g (6.6-lb) female newborn delivered at term to a 23-year-old primigravida mother. The mother reports having had no prenatal care, and immunization records for the newborn are not available.

speaker: Doctor

DIAGNOSIS READY: Congenital Syphilis.

The history of no prenatal care and lack of immunization records in a newborn with specific findings is highly suggestive of congenital syphilis. I will proceed with a serological workup for confirmation. REQUEST TEST: RPR (Rapid Plasma Reagin) and VDRL (Venereal Disease Research Laboratory). REQUEST TEST: PCR for Treponema pallidum from umbilical cord blood or lesions.
